title: tenant.v1 manifest
description: tenant/tenant.yaml: which company the bundle is for and which interface it was written for. The company must match the platform's registration; the checker refuses a bundle whose manifest says otherwise.

company.description: The company's slug, as the platform registered it.

interface.description: The interface revision the bundle was written for. It only grows and a step only adds; a checker reads its own revision and the one before it, and refuses a newer one.
